_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); ratings, education and information signals

pit_profile.why: S&P Global 'is a leading provider of transparent and independent ratings, benchmarks, analytics and data to the capital and commodity markets worldwide' (Item 1); Item 1A: 'Changes in the volume of securities issued and traded in domestic and/or global capital markets, asset levels and flows into investment products, changes in interest rates and volatility in the financial markets, and volatility in the commodities markets impact our business, financial condition or results of operations.', and no risk factor calling a business cyclical; a fall in debt issuance or the markets it serves cuts revenue; no risk factor names a live disruption theme as a competitive risk

classification.quality_note: S&P Global 'is a leading provider of transparent and independent ratings, benchmarks, analytics and data to the capital and commodity markets worldwide' (Item 1); Item 1A: 'Changes in the volume of securities issued and traded in domestic and/or global capital markets, asset levels and flows into investment products, changes in interest rates and volatility in the financial markets, and volatility in the commodities markets impact our business, financial condition or results of operations.', and no risk factor calling a business cyclical; a fall in debt issuance or the markets it serves cuts revenue; no risk factor names a live disruption theme as a competitive risk. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price fair; Ratio B 1.09x; +82% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.19; conservative 2yr +32%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -27.2%/yr (worst year FY12-FY21, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +38.9%/yr (Q3 revenue + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +38.9%/yr (FY12-FY21 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +43.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY12-FY21); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: SPGI (retrospective, 2022-12-16) ◎ ACCUMULATE — Ratio B 1.09x (76.1% downside to Bear $81 / +69.6% upside to Bull $576) | Adj composite 2.00 vs market 2.19: gap -0.19 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +82% above the EPP floor $187 (19x FY22E $9.82) | Conservative 2-yr case: +32.2% total (+16.1%/yr) | At 34.6x FY22E the 15% hurdle price $449 sits at or below the BASE case; Financial Services revenue +8.5% in Q3 2022, forward revenues +37.1% (no FY22 revenue guide in numbers, Q3 2022 growth); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
